core: 却 marks a contrast between what was expected and what actually happened. It is softer and more nuanced than 但是, often implying surprise, disappointment, or irony about the gap between expectation and reality.

sentences.situation: At a café · with a close friend
sentences.zh: 这家店不贵，咖啡却很好喝。
sentences.pinyin: zhè jiā diàn bù guì, kā fēi què hěn hǎo hē.
sentences.en: This shop is not expensive, but the coffee is surprisingly good.
sentences.why: You are telling your friend about a nice discovery. 却 shows that the good coffee was unexpected given the low prices.
sentences.tip: Stress 却 slightly to emphasize the unexpected contrast.

sentences.situation: At home · talking to your younger sibling
sentences.zh: 他每天都运动，却还是感冒了。
sentences.pinyin: tā měi tiān dōu yùn dòng, què hái shì gǎn mào le.
sentences.en: He exercises every day, but he still caught a cold.
sentences.why: You are commenting on someone who stays healthy by exercising, yet got sick anyway. 却 highlights the contradiction.
sentences.tip: Do not say 但是 here; 却 sounds more natural for this kind of mild surprise.

sentences.situation: At work · chatting with a colleague
sentences.zh: 这个工作不难，却很费时间。
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge gōng zuò bù nán, què hěn fèi shí jiān.
sentences.en: This task is not hard, but it takes a lot of time.
sentences.why: You are explaining to a coworker why the job feels slow. 却 points out the hidden difficulty that is not obvious at first.
sentences.tip: Use 很费时间 instead of saying 很慢 for a more native tone.

sentences.situation: In a taxi · talking to the driver
sentences.zh: 我今天起得很早，却还是迟到了。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ jīn tiān qǐ de hěn zǎo, què hái shì chí dào le.
sentences.en: I got up very early today, but I was still late.
sentences.why: You are explaining to the driver why you are in a hurry. 却 shows your effort did not pay off as expected.
sentences.tip: Add 还是 after 却 to emphasize that the result was unavoidable.

sentences.situation: At a restaurant · complaining to a friend
sentences.zh: 这家餐厅很有名，菜却不好吃。
sentences.pinyin: zhè jiā cān tīng hěn yǒu míng, cài què bù hǎo chī.
sentences.en: This restaurant is very famous, but the food does not taste good.
sentences.why: You are sharing a disappointing experience. 却 contrasts the restaurant's reputation with the actual quality of the food.
sentences.tip: Use 有名 instead of 贵 here; the contrast is between fame and quality.

sentences.situation: At work · talking to your manager
sentences.zh: 我想早点回家，却还有很多事要做。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng zǎo diǎn huí jiā, què hái yǒu hěn duō shì yào zuò.
sentences.en: I want to go home early, but I still have a lot of work to do.
sentences.why: You are politely letting your boss know you cannot leave on time. 却 softens the complaint and shows you understand the situation.
sentences.tip: This is a polite way to express frustration without sounding negative.

sentences.situation: On the phone · talking to your mother
sentences.zh: 他嘴上说没关系，心里却很难过。
sentences.pinyin: tā zuǐ shàng shuō méi guān xi, xīn lǐ què hěn nán guò.
sentences.en: He says it is fine, but deep down he is very sad.
sentences.why: You are describing someone who hides their true feelings. 却 contrasts their words with their inner emotions.
sentences.tip: 嘴上...心里却... is a very common pattern for describing hidden feelings.

sentences.situation: At a shop · talking to the salesperson
sentences.zh: 这件衣服很好看，却不太适合我。
sentences.pinyin: zhè jiàn yī fú hěn hǎo kàn, què bù tài shì hé wǒ.
sentences.en: This dress looks very nice, but it is not quite right for me.
sentences.why: You are politely declining to buy something. 却 softens the refusal by acknowledging the item's good points first.
sentences.tip: Add 太 before 适合 to make the refusal sound less harsh.

sentences.situation: At work · WeChat message to a teammate
sentences.zh: 我明明已经发过邮件了，他却还是说没收到。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ míng míng yǐ jīng fā guò yóu jiàn le, tā què hái shì shuō méi shōu dào.
sentences.en: I clearly already sent the email, but he still says he did not receive it.
sentences.why: You are venting to a coworker about a frustrating situation. 明明...却... emphasizes that the situation is clearly unreasonable.
sentences.tip: 明明...却... is a powerful pattern for expressing frustration or disbelief.

sentences.situation: At a dinner · talking to your boss and colleagues
sentences.zh: 虽然他刚来公司不久，工作能力却比很多老员工都强。
sentences.pinyin: suī rán tā gāi lái gōng sī bù jiǔ, gōng zuò néng lì què bǐ hěn duō lǎo yuán gōng dōu qiáng.
sentences.en: Although he has just joined the company recently, his work ability is stronger than many long-time employees.
sentences.why: You are praising a new team member in front of your boss. 却 contrasts his short time at the company with his high skill level.
sentences.tip: 虽然...却... is a formal pattern used in speeches and written reports.

quiz.prompt: You are telling your friend that the movie had a famous director, but the story was boring. Use 却.
quiz.answer: 这个电影导演很有名，故事却很无聊。
accept: 这部电影导演很有名，剧情却很无聊。
这个电影导演很有名，却不好看。
quiz.explain: 却 contrasts the director's fame with the boring story, showing the contrast between expectation and reality.

quiz.prompt: You are explaining to your classmate that you studied for the test, but you still got a bad grade. Use 却.
quiz.answer: 我复习了很久，却还是没考好。
accept: 我学习了很久，却还是没及格。
我准备了很久，却还是没考好。
quiz.explain: 却 shows that your effort did not lead to the expected result, expressing mild frustration.

quiz.prompt: You are politely telling your manager that you want to rest this weekend, but you still have to finish a report. Use 却.
quiz.answer: 我这周末想休息，却还得写报告。
accept: 我想周末休息，却还有报告要写。
我这周末想休息，却还要写报告。
quiz.explain: 却 softens the complaint by contrasting your wish with your obligation, sounding polite and understanding.

quiz.prompt: You are comforting your friend who says they are fine, but you know they are sad. Use 却.
quiz.answer: 你嘴上说没事，心里却很难过吧。
accept: 你嘴上说没关系，心里却不好受吧。
你说没事，心里却很难过吧。
quiz.explain: 嘴上...却... contrasts their words with their true feelings, showing you care and understand them.

quiz.prompt: 你的朋友问你：「这家餐厅怎么样？」你回答说：「虽然人很多，但是味道很一般。」请用「却」改写这句话。
quiz.answer: 虽然人很多，味道却很一般。
accept: 虽然人很多，菜却不好吃。
quiz.explain: 虽然...却... is a natural pattern for contrasting the restaurant's popularity with its average taste.

quiz.prompt: 你的同事问你：「你今天怎么迟到了？」你回答说：「我明明起得很早，但是路上堵车了。」请用「却」改写这句话。
quiz.answer: 我明明起得很早，路上却堵车了。
accept: 我明明起得很早，却遇到堵车了。
我起得很早，却还是堵车了。
quiz.explain: 明明...却... emphasizes that your early start did not help because of the unexpected traffic.
